params.body:
Shane: the dealer settings are "slordig op mobile". Every pane was rendered at 390x844 as an administrator. The section list, Showroom, Achtergrond, Bijlagen, AI, Transport and Verlengde waarborg already read well (transport and the worklists dialog had their rounds in #371 and #387 and are untouched). Four panes did not.

## What was wrong on a phone

1. **Showroomaffiche, opties sorteren.** The rows are Bootstrap (`row` with `col-1`/`col-6`/`col-5`), kept because jQuery UI sortable selects `div.row`. The theme sets `.d-flex { display: block !important }` under 768px, so the handle stood above a two-line name with the group under it: ten options, thirty lines, no rule between them.
2. **Locaties.** The only pane without a title, a lone add button floating right, and the content in a `col-12` outside any row, indented 15px further than every other pane (on desktop too).
3. **Koppelingen.** A `<dl>` per service: the theme makes `<dt>` bold and the Bootstrap margin of the `<dl>` stacked on `mb-4` and the grid gap, so the two services stood 60px apart.
4. **Website.** The copy button stood alone on a third line under the iframe url (the buttons were not in the `ui-copy-link-actions` wrapper the showroom tab uses); the range row put label, switch and select side by side so the label read "Met ... es"; Weergave and Thema had a three-line label beside a 220px select.
5. Small: the label and button "download" on the showroom tab were the only lowercase words on the screen.

## What changed

- `ui-sort-list` on the sortable wrapper: under 768px one 44px line per option (handle, name, group in grey on the right, a hairline between). `display: flex !important` because the theme makes it block. Desktop columns and the sortable's `div.row` selector are unchanged.
- Locations: a title row with the add button in it (`ui-section-title--row`), the same pattern as the address lists on the transport tab; the `col-12` is gone.
- Koppelingen: `ui-subsection` + `ui-toggle-list` per service, the vocabulary of the website options.
- Website: Openen and Kopieer in one `ui-copy-link-actions` (Openen now with a label, as on Showroom); the three rows with a select carry `ui-toggle-row--field`, which under 576px puts the label above a full-width control.
- Showroom: `ucfirst` on the download label and button.

**Desktop, deliberately changed:** the Locaties title with the button beside it and the 15px indent that is gone; hairlines and regular weight in Koppelingen; "Openen" as text on the iframe-url button; the capital D. Every other pane and the tab bar are pixel-equal.

**Deliberately left:** the tab bar wraps into two rows between 768 and about 1100px; a horizontally scrolling strip would clip the Service / Diensten menu, and two rows of tabs read fine. The address lists (Locaties, Transport) keep the `ui-list` card mode.

## Rules and tests

- New rule R P2-10.19 (the settings on a phone) in `32-p2-mijn-garage.md`.
- `tests/Feature/SettingsPhoneLayoutTest` (`@rule P2-10.19`): renders the panes and pins the markup and the CSS rules the phone layout hangs on.
- Finding `docs/bedrijfsregels/bevindingen/2026-09-15-instellingen-slordig-op-telefoon.md` (opgelost).
- `vendor/bin/phpunit --filter "Settings|StylesheetSyntax|AlpineExpression|HandlerWiring|CompiledViews|RulesCoverage|RulesIdentity|TransportChain"`: OK (98 tests, 1224 assertions).

Screenshots before/after per tab at 390 and at 1440 in the worktree's `.playwright-mcp/settings-phone/`.
params.title: The settings screen reads on a phone
